note: Both sets contain identical claims with the same errors, including duplicate entries for plate thicknesses (1", 3/8", 1/2") and truncated quotes (e.g., "3" DIA ST", "4 X 3/8" C"). Both sets correctly identify key components like bolts, cap plates, and pipes but fail to distinguish between the different details consistently, often labeling everything "Crane Attachment Detail". Neither set extracts the "1 1/2" HOLE" dimension present in the text layer.
